evidence.notes: Local Database.getQueryLocator increments the query-locator row counter for materialized local rows.
Local Limits exposes the query-locator row cap.
Local Database.rollback increments the savepoint rollback counter.
Local Limits exposes the savepoint rollback cap.

source.content: insert new Account(Name = 'one'); System.assertEquals(0, Limits.getQueryLocatorRows()); Database.getQueryLocator('SELECT Id FROM Account'); System.assertEquals(1, Limits.getQueryLocatorRows()); System.assertEquals(10000, Limits.getLimitQueryLocatorRows()); System.assertEquals(0, Limits.getSavepointRollbacks()); System.Savepoint sp = Database.setSavepoint(); insert new Account(Name = 'two'); Database.rollback(sp); System.assertEquals(1, Limits.getSavepointRollbacks()); System.assertEquals(100, Limits.getLimitSavepointRollbacks());
